content: ruff 0.16.1 (lint + format, replaces black/isort/flake8). prettier 3.9.6. pre-commit orchestrates both: ruff-pre-commit hook repo with ruff-check --fix and ruff-format ids, plus mirrors-prettier or a local node hook for TS/MD/JSON. Keep ruff config in the Python package pyproject.toml [tool.ruff] and scope prettier to apps/dashboard via .prettierignore so the two never fight over the same files.
